_doc: Shared contract for the model-id canonicalizer. tools/safety_e2e/model_id.py and mira-hub/tests/safety-e2e/model-id.ts must both satisfy every row (tests/test_safety_e2e_model_id.py, mira-hub/tests/safety-e2e/model-id.test.ts). canonical: lowercase, trim, strip a provider prefix (up to the last '/'), strip ':latest'. family: canonical, minus any ':tag' and any trailing -YYYY-MM-DD snapshot date.
